name: Armeyskoye Leto
source:
Tired of the endless pioneers, of Semyon's whining, or the standard pioneer girls? Want to repay your debt to your beloved Sovyonok? Then welcome to the army!

Our protagonists will have to witness all the absurdity of this universe. What is happening around them cannot be explained with normal words. Will they be able to repay their "debt" to the pioneer camp in the five days they're given?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2454338419]Steam[/url]]
